change_reason: R3 showed that gather-once then broadcast wins 11 of 12 fixed high-overlap settings. R4 varies source key overlap, measures the result-to-partial size ratio, and tests the derived architecture boundary.
query: SELECT key, SUM(value), COUNT(*) FROM facts WHERE epoch <= ? GROUP BY key ORDER BY key
primary_window_reason: The primary window ends one lag budget after the last source-commit frontier because primary_lag_ticks equals two version periods. Longer tails measure update-stop aging and remain sensitivity cases.

direct_methods.provenance: Controlled complete-exchange specialization; not a reproduction of F1 Query or TQP.
Oldest-ready specialization of the FIFO comparator evaluated by Labrinidis and Roussopoulos.
Destination-age-first specialization of the highest-current-age principle; not a wireless-policy reproduction.
Popularity divided by positive remaining declared edge work; an R40 specialization, not native QoDA.
Safe source-side replacement and closure priority on deterministic shortest paths.
Safe replacement and closure priority plus projected-maximum-edge-work path assignment.
Best of sixteen frozen random orders and paths without version replacement.
Best of sixteen frozen random orders and paths with safe source-side replacement.

gather_broadcast_methods.provenance: Reduce-to-one followed by broadcast, with FIFO transfer service and every version retained.
The literature-derived gather-broadcast architecture with our safe waiting-version replacement and closure priority.

architecture_boundary.equality_policy: choose the lower predicted maximum physical-edge work; then total bytes; then deterministic method id

freshness_reference: The last source commit included in an installed version. The no-installed-version state never satisfies the lag target.
root_policy: Run every site as root. Report the topology medoid as the executable default and the post-hoc best root as an explicit oracle.
replacement_rule: A transfer may be discarded only while it is still waiting at its current creation source and a newer cumulative object for the same logical receiver is ready. In-flight and relayed transfers are preserved.
